title: Dominic and the Machine
author: Petra Villalobos
blurb: Mirabel Ashgrove, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
